title: Iterated Nerve Complexes for k-Fold Sensor Coverage
content: We construct a k-shadow complex Δ_k(N) from the nerve N of a convex sensor cover. We prove that the region covered by at least k sensors is homotopy equivalent to Δ_k(N), recovering the usual nerve-based coverage test when k=1 and giving a direct combinatorial method for redundant coverage. A synthetic network computation for k=1,2 agrees with direct geometric sampling, and the scripts and data are supplied for reproduction.
